note: NECO Literature round 3 (Round 22 top-up): apostrophe, satire, sarcasm, allegory, juxtaposition, symbolism, imagery, pathos vs bathos, cliché, euphony vs cacophony, quatrain, octave, epigram, dirge, pastoral, conceit, epic, aubade, antihero, antagonist, archetype, setting, in medias res, plot, chorus, monologue, prologue, farce, comedy of manners, melodrama, stage directions, and African writers: Rotimi's Odewale play, Tutuola's Palm-Wine Drinkard, Armah's independence novel, Ngugi's Weep Not, Child, Okara's two musics, Awoonor's forge, Soyinka's Horseman, Osundare the teacher, Angelou's caged bird, Amadi's Sunset in Biafra, Nwapa's Efuru and Emecheta's motherhood novel. Scanned against NECO rounds 1-2, WAEC Literature (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
